text:
nishant: Quick sanity check — FlashAttn v3 looks faster on H100 us-east but in eu-west it's spiking p95 for raven-7b after quant to q8. Anyone else see this?

maria: saw the runs. us-east p95 ~34ms, eu-west p95 jumped to ~52ms on flashv3 vs ~44ms on flashv2.

sam: are those cold-starts or steady-state? perf numbers with steady batching?

nishant: steady-state, 8-token warmup, batching off (latency mode). logs attached from rbench run.

emily: curious if it's kernel fusion mismatch with our network MTU in eu-west. vendor kernels (Triton + cuBLASLt) didn't show the same jump there.

dennis: can you paste rbench command?

nishant: `rbench run --model raven-7b --quant q8 --region eu-west --kernel flashv3 --mode latency --warmup 8 --runs 200`

maria: comparing traces: flashv3 had CPU->GPU memcpy spikes at certain hostgroups. Looks like a kernel kickoff jitter, not pure compute.

deploy-bot: deploy 2148761 started for kernel-experiment (eu-west) — logs pushed to /artifacts/kernel-eval/2148765432

sam: for rollouts I propose conservative rule: only switch to flashv3 in region if p95_improvement >= 10% AND p99 no-regression. Otherwise keep flashv2 and monitor.

emily: also add capacity sizing check — flashv3 may need different queue depth. Our autoscaler currently tuned for flashv2 throughput curves.

nishant: action items: (1) run microtrace with nvprof on problematic hosts, (2) run vendor-kernel (Triton) baseline in eu-west, (3) adjust autoscaler sim to flashv3 latenc y curve.

dennis: acked. I'll queue nvprof run and post results here.

quant-bot: note — q8 quantization shows non-linear latency on H100 when combined with flashv3; logging in experiment dashboard.

maria: adding a temporary routing policy: route raven-7b traffic in eu-west to flashv2 until we have nvprof evidence. :white_check_mark: 

nishant: thanks — will follow up with plots tomorrow (throughput vs p95 by kernel + region).
